findings.description: The kernel recorded 6 ICMP packet(s) between the device and 8.8.8.8. Luca's capture filter keeps only TCP and UDP, so this traffic is absent from the capture and from the Zeek and Suricata analysis. ICMP is often benign (reachability tests, error reports); check whether 8.8.8.8 is expected.
findings.title: ICMP exchanged with 8.8.8.8 outside the local network.

findings.description: The kernel recorded 3 packet(s) of ESP between the device and 203.0.113.7. Protocols other than TCP, UDP and ICMP are typically tunnels or VPNs (for example IPsec ESP or GRE). Luca's capture filter excludes them, so their content and destinations were not analysed further.
findings.title: ESP traffic with 203.0.113.7, invisible to the capture.

findings.description: Inferred, not measured: 1 flow(s) left the device with a TTL/hop limit 1 below the device's usual initial value (64). A decremented TTL normally means another host, virtual machine or container sends traffic through the device (for example hotspot tethering). Applications can also set their own TTL, so this is an indication to verify, not a conclusion.
findings.title: Traffic that appears to be forwarded through the device.

findings.description: The kernel recorded 1 packet(s) arriving from the device with source address 10.99.0.5, which is outside the access point's prefixes (192.168.100.0/24). This happens with forwarding or misconfigured devices and with address spoofing; which one cannot be determined at this vantage point.
findings.title: Packets from 10.99.0.5, outside the access point's network.

limitations: Corroboration means two collection paths inside the same host kernel agree: the TC classifier and the AF_PACKET capture. Both depend on the configured interface being the access point.
Kernel flows aggregate every packet of a 5-tuple over the collector's lifetime, which starts before and ends after the capture; per-flow counts can exceed the capture's.
Retransmission counts are passive estimates (data below the highest sequence already seen).
note: SYNTHETIC OFFLINE EXAMPLE. Computed from invented packets in observatory/tests/fixtures.py; no kernel, network or device was observed.
